As a Warehouse Operator in Rotterdam, you play an important role in handling and preparing parts for electric scooters, bicycles, and e-scooters. You make sure everything is picked, packed, and shipped correctly, so customers receive their orders on time. A great opportunity to work in a fast-growing and sustainable industry with a motivated team. Good work!Over de functieAs a Warehouse Operator, you work with a wide range of parts – from small components like screws to complete bikes and scooters. You help keep the warehouse running smoothly from start to finish.Your tasks include:- Receiving and inspecting incoming shipments- Ensuring inventory accuracy- Picking, packing, and preparing orders for shipment- Supporting physically demanding warehouse tasks as required by the operation- Maintaining a safe and clean work environmentThis is a full-time position (40 hours per week).Working hours: Monday to Friday, 07:30 – 16:00Over het bedrijfThis company is an international leader in smart mobility solutions, focused on sustainable transport such as electric scooters, bicycles, and e-scooters. Their mission is to make cities cleaner, more efficient, and more accessible through innovative mobility.You will work in a modern, international warehouse environment with motivated colleagues from all over the world, contributing to a fast-growing and future-oriented industry.Wat wij vragenGood command of the English languageExperience in a warehouse environment is a plusTeam player with a positive and flexible attitudeMotivation and willingness to learnWe are also curious about your experience and motivation — surprise us!Wat wij biedenStarting salary from €15 gross per hourFull-time job (40 hours per week)International working environmentWeekly payments25 vacation days + 8.00% holiday allowancePension schemeStable job in a growing and sustainable industr
